title: Linear Sliding Mode Controller (State Feedback)
text: Design sliding mode control with knowledge of linear systems using state feedback, 3 inputs, 2 outputs, {Control Gain (K)} sets Control gain; {A} sets the state matrix, {B} sets the input, {C} sets the output, {Am} sets the reference model state, {Bm} sets the reference model input {Task Mode} sets the mode of operation, {Output Switching Function}, {Include derivative reference signal} sets the derivative of reference signal externally, {Sr} sets the design matrix for reference tracking, {Tuning Method} sets the sliding surface design method Pole, {Pole Location} sets the pole location for pole placement method, {Weighted Matrix} sets the weighted matrix for quadratic performance index, {Export Hyperplane Matrix S} sets the send designed hyperplane matrix to MATLAB ® workspace, {S} sets the user-defined hyperplane, {Reaching Law} sets the reaching law Constant, {Reaching Rate (η)} sets the reaching rate, {Power Rate Exponent (α)} sets the power rate exponent, {Select Boundary Layer} sets the boundary layer function, {Phi} sets the boundary layer thickness, {Enable zero-crossing detection}, {Time domain} sets the controller time domain, {Sample time} and {Integrator method} sets the discrete-time integration method Forward. Values come from the instance.
